fudgey & chewy 🤤 if you prefer brownie corners & crinkly tops, you’ll absolutely love these!!  ingredients: 350g powdered sugar (a little less than 3 cups, but you can use 3 cups as well since this recipe is pretty forgiving) 60-65g cocoa powder (about 8-10 tablespoons if using tablespoons however using a scale is the best because tbsp weights may vary) – you can adjust this to 60g of cocoa powder if you prefer a sweeter cookie! 1/2 tsp salt 3 egg whites from 3 large eggs! (about 1/2 cup of liquid egg whites) 1/2 to 1 cup semi sweet chocolate chips (optional but recommended!) – depending how much chocolate you like! you can also use milk but i'm a semi sweet/dark choco girl. 1 tsp instant coffee (use 1/2 tsp if you are caffeine sensitive) 1 tsp vanilla bean paste (optional but adds great flavor) **if you live in a hot climate and the dough is super runny, try putting it in the fridge for 30 mins to an hour before baking**  directions: preheat oven to 350°f (175°c). line a baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly butter it so the cookies do not stick. in a large bowl, add powdered sugar, cocoa powder, salt, egg whites, instant coffee, and vanilla bean paste. stir until a thick glossy batter forms. fold in the chocolate chips if you are using them. scoop 2 to 3 tablespoons of batter per cookie onto the prepared baking sheet. leave at least 4 to 5 inches between each cookie because they spread a lot while baking. four to a cookie sheet will definitely prevent them from touching, but you can fit six if you do not mind if they bake into each other a bit. place the cookie tray directly in the middle of your oven. bake for 8 to 10 minutes. at 8 minutes the cookies will cool into a very fudgy texture. the longer you bake them, the less fudgy they will be. ten minutes should be the maximum baking time. immediately after baking, use a round bowl to gently scoot and round out the cookies. this will help “fluff” up the edges, which can be a bit flat right out of the oven. remove the cookies from the baking sheet right after shaping so they do not continue cooking on the hot tray. transfer to a cooling rack and let them cool completely before eating. enjoy!!! tips: -for the fudgiest texture, stick closer to 8 minutes of baking time.  -bake in the middle of the oven to prevent burning. use good quality cocoa powder for a richer chocolate flavor.  -if you don’t like coffee, you can skip the instant coffee, but it really brings out the chocolate taste.  -make sure to leave plenty of space between cookies because they spread a lot. four to a cookie sheet will keep them from touching, six if you are fine with them touching a little.  -transfer the cookies off the baking sheet right away so they stay soft in the middle.  -immediately after baking, use a round bowl to gently scoot and round out the cookies. this helps “fluff” up the edges, which can be a bit flat straight from the oven. #brownie #cookies #flourless #baking #glutenfree

Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

videos.caption: POV: you have a late night cookie craving  My fiancé and I were CRAVING cookies the other night and I was so thankful that I had frozen cookie dough balls waiting and ready to go.. freezing cookie dough is a life hack that we all need to get on board with for when the craving hits  Ingredients  makes 12 cookies  150g / 1 ¼ cups plain flour  ½ tsp baking soda 100g / ½ cup granulated sugar  160g / ¾ cup soft light brown sugar  ½ tsp salt (+ flakey salt for end) 115g/ ½ cup melted unsalted butter  1 egg / flax egg  1 tsp vanilla extract 80g / 3 oz milk chocolate chopped / chunks 80g/ 3 oz dark chocolate chopped / chunks  Instructions  1. Whisk your sugars, salt and butter together. Then add your vanilla and egg. Combine until ribbons form, don’t over whisk. 2. Fold in your flour and baking soda with a spoon. Then add your chopped chocolate, leaving a small amount back to press into the top of your cookie dough balls once formed. Place this mixture in the fridge for 40 minutes- 1 hour.  3. Use an ice cream scoop to make cookie dough balls, then press chocolate on to the top (or you can wait until after freezing to do this like i did). Freeze on a tray/ plate until ready to bake. I recommend doing this for at least an hour even if you want to bake today! Once frozen, you can transfer the balls into a paper and pop back in the freezer for easy storing. 4. Pre-heat oven to 180C/ 360F. Place cookies on a tray lined with baking paper and bake for 8-10 minutes. Then take out the oven and leave to set for 20ish minutes. If you try to eat them straight from the oven, they are delicious but they will fall apart so be patient! Finish with some flakey salt. Then, enjoy  #cookies #latenight #latenightcravings #cookiedough #gooey #cookie #chocolatechipcookies #cravings

HOW TO MAKE SALT BREAD 🥐 i wanted to answer some of the questions i was getting about my salt bread recipe so i wanted to make a longer more in depth tutorial recipe link: https://erinscozykitchen.com/recipe/salt-bread-shiopan/ or look up "erinscozykitchen salt bread" on google and it should be the first link that pops up! - can i replace milk powder with milk: yes you can just replace some or all the water with milk but it will change the crumb and texture and browning, if u can i would recommend using milk powder - why cold water: when you knead your dough it will rise the temp and you want it to end up at around 78 fahrenheit when u go to do the first rise. high dough temp will affect the taste and gluten development of the dough - why is my dough sticky: your dough has either gotten too high in temp that the gluten is breaking down or you haven't kneaded it long enough and it's just underdeveloped (DONT add more flour to your dough just bc it's sticky while you're kneading it shouldn't need any flour if you kneaded it long enough). i have made these hundreds of times and i promise if you knead it long enough even if it takes a while it will come together eventually and get less sticky! if you have tried all these steps and the dough is still too difficult to work with you can try changing the unsalted butter amount to 30g instead of 40g. My current recipe is on the higher side of fat content which is why it takes a longer time to knead and for the dough to come together. if you use 30g it should come together faster and be easier to manage but will still taste good!  - how long do you knead: this depends on your mixer and speed, with my ooni halo pro it took me about 14 min total but with a kitchen aid it could take longer and by hand even longer  - where is my salt bread pan from: i got it in korea at bangsan market! it's a neighborhood that sells a lot of wholesale baking and packaging supplies. i couldn't find anything similar in the states but tbh i don't think it really makes that big of a difference! tips: • make sure you fridge your butter after you cut it, you want to roll it up with hard/cold sticks of butter • for cute fat salt bread make the top width of your rolled out inverted triangle short • start preheating your oven around 25 min after your final shaping while they're rising so they're not overproofed by the time your oven is ready • make sure to use a nonstick coated baking pan for your rolls! a plain aluminum pan will cause your rolls to stick it needs to be non stick coated :)  STORAGE • salt bread tastes best fresh out of the oven! if you don't finish them freeze them in a ziploc and to reheat, air fry at 350 f for 5-8 min #saltbread #shiopan #소금빵

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. videos.caption: Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Fresh rosemary – 2 tbsp, finely chopped 6. Fresh thyme – 1 tbsp, chopped 7. Honey – 3 tbsp 8. Soy sauce – 2 tbsp 9. Dijon mustard – 1 tbsp 10. Lemon juice – 1 tbsp 11. Smoked paprika – 1 tsp 12. Black pepper – 1 tsp 13. Kosher salt – 1 tsp 14. Beef or lamb broth – 1/2 cup 15. Fresh parsley – 2 tbsp, chopped Recipe 1. Pat the lamb chops thoroughly dry with paper towels so the surface can develop a deep golden-brown crust during cooking. 2. In a bowl, combine the olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Rub the herb mixture generously over both sides of every lamb chop. 3. Cover the seasoned lamb chops and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours, allowing the herbs and garlic to penetrate the meat. 4. Remove the lamb from the refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking so it can lose some of its chill and cook more evenly. 5. Preheat the oven to 400°F and heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the butter and allow it to melt and become lightly foamy. 6. Arrange the lamb chops in the hot skillet without overcrowding them. Sear for 2 to 3 minutes per side until a dark, caramelized crust forms. 7. Mix the honey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, and lamb or beef broth in a small bowl until smooth. 8. Pour the honey-garlic sauce around the lamb chops and spoon some of it over the tops. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven. 9. Roast the lamb for 5 to 8 minutes, depending on thickness and desired doneness, until the meat reaches the preferred internal temperature. 10. Remove the skillet from the oven and baste the lamb repeatedly with the hot buttery sauce, allowing the glaze to coat the browned crust. 11. Let the lamb chops rest in the skillet for 5 minutes so the juices redistribute while the sauce thickens slightly. 12. Arrange the lamb chops on a large serving platter and drizzle the remaining honey-herb sauce over the top. 13. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley and a few additional rosemary and thyme sprigs for a finished presentation. 14. Serve immediately with warm dinner rolls, roasted potatoes, vegetables, or a fresh green salad alongside the glazed lamb chops. 🤯UNBELIEVABLE SLOW COOKER BEEF This is such an easy recipe and it’s so versatile for ridiculously easy healthy meals throughout the week like these loaded sweet potato. All you need is a slow cooker, just 5 minutes of prep, and you’re good to go. You can roast sweet potato, regular potato, or serve these over quinoa, any kind of rice, or if youre lowcarb my high protein lowcarb kaizen rice. Here is how I made it: 1.Grab a slow cooker. Add 3lbs of cut chuck roast or boneless short ribs cut into about 2 inch chunks. Dont put a huge piece in! 2.To the beef add 1 thinly sliced yellow onion, 5-6 minced garlic cloves, 1 to 1.5tbsp freshly grated ginger, 1/2 cup soy or tamari sauce, 3/4 cup bone broth, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp honey (or sugar free honey), 1 tsp sesame oil, and some chili flakes to taste. 3.Put the lid on and let it go for 8 hours on slow. 4.When youre read to eat, shred the beef up with a fork. 5.I roasted a large sweet potato - just put it in the oven at 350F for 75 minutes. Again, use regular rice, my kaizen lowcarb rice, quinoa, or regular potato if you wish. 6.Make a simple low calorie cucumber salad by thinly slicing 3 persian cucumbers, squeeze the juice of 1/2 lime, add 2 tbsp rice vinegar, season with salt, and add 1/2 tsp Korean or Aleppo chili flakes.
